coder_notes: Sonodynamic therapy: hematoporphyrin (Hiporfin) is the only investigational drug, activated by focused ultrasound, so device_dependent true. Temozolomide and bevacizumab are given in both arms as standard therapy. Detailed description says adults receive Hiporfin intra-arterially (coded new_route); the same text mentions children receiving IV dosing, and eligibility ages include CHILD. Target engagement unclear: ROS levels are planned only as a correlative biomarker with response.
